properties.name: Heimdall
properties.description: A colossal wall of water out in the Sea to the Great Unknown. No ship has ever made it through.
properties.details:
Heimdall rises out of the sea to the south-west of Kelnara and curves away on a slight radius, seemingly without end.

Many ships have tried to sail through it, and none has ever returned. Others have sailed along it, trying to reach its end. Some of their wrecks have been found, and pieces have floated back, but nothing more.
